proves.claim: rebarHoldReason returns re-bar text keeping the original when a reason names a withdrawn item and only landed or withdrawn items, and null for landed-only, open or no items.

store.logic-board-holds-settled.withdraw.why: Without this test, a hold on a withdrawn dependency could be lifted as if the work had landed (#12470).

proves.claim: liftSettledHolds on a withdraw event rewrites a hold naming a withdrawn item to re-bar text and logs it instead of lifting it, while a landed-only hold still lifts.

store.logic-board-holds-settled.withdraw.why: Without this test, the withdraw path could silently lift a hold whose dependency never delivered (#12470).
